packet.headline_seed: Hit South African show gets the world talking about polygamy and cheating
packet.description_seed: The Zulu-language series about a man with multiple wives is a worldwide hit.

what: Hit South African show gets the world talking about polygamy and cheating

clean_source_blocks.text: The show opens at the funeral of Jonasi Gomora, with two of his wives as chief mourners One of Netflix's hottest and sassiest new dramas has not only South Africa but the world talking about marriage, betrayal, revenge and the contentious issue of polygamy - the practice of having more than one spouse at the same time. The Polygamist, a 22-episode Zulu-language series, is about the tangled love life of wealthy Johannesburg businessman Jonasi Gomora. It begins at the fictional tycoon's funeral where we learn that his widow Joyce, a social media influencer wearing a striking white outfit, is not his only partner. In fact, he has two other wives and a mistress - who are all there dressed in black.
The Zulu-language series about a man with multiple wives is a worldwide hit.

Emotions explode as secrets are laid bare - and in a dramatic rollercoaster, the plot spirals back over five years to explain their relationships and toxic family dynamics. Released by the streaming giant on 12 June, the show topped trend lists within hours and social media has been lit up since with reactions to the controversial plot twists - some people sharing memes and their own experiences about polygamy and faithless marriages. Some minibus "matatu" taxis in Kenya's capital, Nairobi, have been redecorated with Jonasi's face or name such is the show's popularity there and the debate around his behaviour. Even Nigerian Afrobeats star Davido tweeted, external: "Yo JONASI is WILD" - and Hollywood celebrities have chipped in too.

"I thought Crazy Rich Asians was something, but crazy rich Africans is a whole 'nother level," Emmy-award winning talk-show host and actress Sherri Shepherd said on Instagram, external. In reply to the post, Taraji P Henson - star of hits including Hidden Figures and Empire - said the show had had her in a "chokehold" and she had binged it in one day. Based on the 2012 novel by Zimbabwean author Sue Nyathi, The Polygamist has been adapted for the screen by Netflix in collaboration with South African production company Stained Glass TV.

The Polygamist, a 22-episode Zulu-language series, is about the tangled love life of wealthy Johannesburg businessman Jonasi Gomora.

It begins at the fictional tycoon's funeral where we learn that his widow Joyce, a social media influencer wearing a striking white outfit, is not his only partner. In fact, he has two other wives and a mistress - who are all there dressed in black.

Emotions explode as secrets are laid bare - and in a dramatic rollercoaster, the plot spirals back over five years to explain their relationships and toxic family dynamics.

Released by the streaming giant on 12 June, the show topped trend lists within hours and social media has been lit up since with reactions to the controversial plot twists - some people sharing memes and their own experiences about polygamy and faithless marriages.

"I thought Crazy Rich Asians was something, but crazy rich Africans is a whole 'nother level," Emmy-award winning talk-show host and actress Sherri Shepherd said on Instagram, external.

In reply to the post, Taraji P Henson - star of hits including Hidden Figures and Empire - said the show had had her in a "chokehold" and she had binged it in one day.

Based on the 2012 novel by Zimbabwean author Sue Nyathi, The Polygamist has been adapted for the screen by Netflix in collaboration with South African production company Stained Glass TV.

The executive producers include two daughters of Jacob Zuma - South Africa's former president and a proud polygamist who is greatly respected by his supporters for upholding his cultural and traditional Zulu beliefs. The 84-year-old currently has four wives, has been married six times and is estimated to have 20 children.

Gugu Zuma-Ncube and Thuli Zuma's parents divorced in 1998 after 16 years of marriage - and another of their half-siblings is also credited as a writer on the series.

payload.title: Zulu-kielinen The Polygamist nousi Netflix-hitiksi ja herätti keskustelun moniavioisuudesta
payload.summary: Eteläafrikkalainen The Polygamist on noussut kansainväliseksi puheenaiheeksi pian julkaisunsa jälkeen. Zulu-kielinen Netflix-sarja käsittelee avioliittoa, pettämistä, kostoa ja moniavioisuutta fiktiivisen liikemiehen perhesuhteiden kautta.
payload.content:
Eteläafrikkalainen zulu-kielinen draamasarja The Polygamist on noussut laajaksi kansainväliseksi puheenaiheeksi Netflixissä. 22-osainen sarja seuraa varakkaan johannesburgilaisen liikemiehen Jonasi Gomoran monimutkaista rakkauselämää ja käsittelee avioliittoa, pettämistä, kostoa sekä moniavioisuutta.

## Hautajaisista paljastusten ketjuun

Sarja alkaa fiktiivisen Jonasi Gomoran hautajaisista. Katsojalle selviää nopeasti, ettei näkyvästi valkoiseen pukeutunut leski Joyce ole hänen ainoa puolisonsa. Paikalla ovat myös kaksi muuta vaimoa sekä rakastajatar, jotka on kuvattu mustiin pukeutuneina.

Tarinan jännite rakentuu salaisuuksien paljastumisesta. Juoni palaa viiden vuoden taakse selittämään henkilöhahmojen suhteita ja perheen sisäisiä, myrkyllisiksi kuvattuja dynamiikkoja. Sarjan keskiössä on kiistanalainen moniavioisuus eli useamman puolison samanaikainen avioliitto, mutta sen ympärille kietoutuvat myös uskottomuus ja valta-asemat.

## Some-ilmiö levisi Etelä-Afrikan ulkopuolelle

The Polygamist julkaistiin 12. kesäkuuta, ja se nousi trendilistoille muutamassa tunnissa. Sarjan käänteet ovat synnyttäneet sosiaalisessa mediassa vilkasta keskustelua, meemejä sekä henkilökohtaisia kertomuksia moniavioisuudesta ja uskottomista avioliitoista.

Suosion on kerrottu näkyvän myös Keniassa. Nairobin matatu-minibusseja on koristeltu Jonasin kasvoilla tai nimellä, mikä kertoo sarjan saamasta huomiosta ja sen päähenkilön käytöksen ympärille syntyneestä keskustelusta.

## Romaanista kansainväliseksi sarjaksi

Sarja on huomattu myös viihdemaailmassa. Nigerialainen afrobeats-tähti Davido kommentoi Jonasia voimakkaasti sosiaalisessa mediassa. Yhdysvaltalainen juontaja ja näyttelijä Sherri Shepherd vertasi sarjan yltäkylläistä maailmaa Crazy Rich Asians -elokuvaan, ja näyttelijä Taraji P. Henson kertoi katsoneensa sarjan yhdessä päivässä.

The Polygamist perustuu zimbabwelaiskirjailija Sue Nyathin vuonna 2012 julkaistuun romaaniin. Netflix on sovittanut sen televisiosarjaksi yhdessä eteläafrikkalaisen Stained Glass TV -tuotantoyhtiön kanssa.
